title: Silver Rewards Card: How to File a Travel Insurance Claim
summary: This document explains how to file a travel insurance claim for the Silver Rewards Card, including required pre-checks (trip must be charged to your card and the incident must be in up to 5 covered categories per your policy). It outlines the step-by-step process, required documents, submission via the insurer portal/channel, a per-trip reimbursement cap of $15,000, and what happens after submission (confirmation, claim reference number, and payment less sub-limits/exclusions).
